info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Posnjaki Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation and management of detailed information for the Posnjaki pendant catalog. It enables businesses to submit new pendant details, including descriptions, specifications, and images. Typical users of this API include e-commerce platforms and catalog management systems looking to enrich their product offerings. By providing a structured approach to managing pendant details, this API supports enhanced product visibility and customer engagement.

post.summary: Create new details for a Posnjaki pendant.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and store new details for a specific Posnjaki pendant. By providing the required data, users can ensure that all relevant information about the pendant is captured accurately for future reference.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the details for the pendant object. This should include all relevant fields necessary for creating or updating the pendant details.
